title: iuup: Improve payload decoding when no pseudohdr available
description:
It seems initial IuUP dissector support was used through some specific
stack where a pseuheader of 2 bytes is prepended to the IuUP header.
This was used to identify the iuup_circuit.

However, in UDP/RTP/IuUP stack, the pseudoheader is not there, and hence
the conversation was not being tracked so far.
As a result, the IuUP payload could not ve decoded because the RFCI
information (shared during IuUP Init) and stored in iuup_circuit could
not be looked up.

This patch stores the iuup_circuit when no pseudoheader is available by
using the pinfo (UDP/RTP stream).

notes.body:
I'd welcome feedback regarding this.
In the original code there wasn't a free, but afaiu there should be?

~~Pretty sure that [wmem_map_remove](wsutil/wmem/wmem_map.c#L328) does a free of the data (but not key). (`wmem_map_steal` does not.)~~

Sorry, no that's wrong, it just frees the internal map item but not the returned value. Freeing the item is probably correct as it doesn't look to be needed anymore.

changed this line in [version 4 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/17314/diffs?diff_id=1125565051&start_sha=d1b8e2298796b781dd0c5520866b828f38ec4fa6#ad3eb17016aea1d0f9d73ee53232752a5dd9b341_481_481)

Oh sorry @johnthacker , I pushed a new version dropping the comment in the code since I only read your 1st comment, not the 2nd one ammending it.
So now I need to find how to remove and free the structure from there, ideas welcome.

Or maybe we can get this one merged since I'm not really adding a regression, and we can submit a new MR on top of it.
I'm anyway already preparing some code on top of this MR to add support to decode/play IuUP packets from within the integrated RTP Player.
Right it should be freed, otherwise it won't be freed until the file is closed, but this isn't a regression.
